'''Oceankind''' is a spell that allows the user to breathe underwater and greatly enhances their ability to swim, making them almost as fast as a fish. The spell also drastically changes the user's appearance for the aquatic environment, but will wear off once the user is no longer submerged.

== History ==
Oceankind was used by [[Captain Caine]] dive into the depths of [[Alexandria]] without a diving suit. It enabled him to escape the pursuing Huntik team. {{source|The Treasures of Alexandria}}
